no_claim_boundaries: This inventory does not implement a DER parser or change runtime behavior.
It does not prove rustls, rustls-webpki, x509-parser, ring, or any certificate corpus correct.
It records A2's shared exact-leaf policy but does not prove the broader A8 real-peer interoperability matrix.
It does not prove canonical DER, duplicate-extension, critical-extension, time, allocation, or depth bounds for retained residue.
It does not prove live cross-implementation TLS, QUIC, ATP, mTLS, rotation, cancellation, or shutdown.
It does not claim wasm TLS support merely because Cargo metadata contains the edge.
It does not prove performance, broad workspace health, release readiness, or live RCH fleet availability.
It does not authorize changing features, removing x509-parser, deleting files, or cutting over any capability.
